bearer-jwt.description: Telegram-issued JWT. Use POST /api/auth/telegram to obtain one.

info.description: Telegram-shop v2 backend — catalog, auth and admin endpoints.
info.title: tg-shop-v2 API

get.summary: Own profile: name, login, role, 2FA status, trusted devices

post.summary: 2FA re-setup, step 2: code from the new secret; ends all other sessions
2FA re-setup, step 1: current code → new secret
«Забыть все устройства»: every trusted device asks for the code again

get.summary: Last 20 sign-in attempts of this admin

post.summary: Change password (current password + code); ends all other sessions

get.summary: Bot / site / Mini App / payment events, newest first, with optional filters
Recent broadcasts with delivered / not delivered counts and the reasons
Event types (per source) and failure reasons seen, for the filter dropdowns
Counters of the last N hours (default 24) per source: total / failed / skipped
Admins (role, 2FA, last sign-in, devices) and open invites of new admins

post.summary: Invite a new admin / give an existing admin a login (bot sends the link)
New link for an invite (the old one stops working)

patch.summary: Change name / role (role change needs the caller's code)

post.summary: Block: active=false, every session ends, no sign-in at all
Delete an admin without history (otherwise 409 HAS_HISTORY — block instead)

put.summary: «Финансы» on / off: purchase prices, expenses and margin (needs the caller's code)

post.summary: Forget the admin's trusted devices
Reset the admin's 2FA (set up again at next sign-in); ends their sessions
Reset the password: old one dies now, a link to set a new one is sent
Unblock

get.summary: Admin actions, newest first, with optional filters
Distinct actions, entity types and admins for the filter dropdowns
Brands with product counts

post.summary: Upload a brand logo: SVG/PNG/WebP (returns S3 key for logoUrl)

delete.summary: Delete brand (its products keep existing without a brand)

post.summary: Merge a brand into another (products move, the name becomes an alias)
Start an async broadcast to the chosen audience

get.summary: Reachable audience sizes (all/active/inactive/premium), optionally for one language
Past broadcasts, newest first (text, audience, result, who)
Progress of the running/last broadcast

post.summary: Send one test message (telegramUserId null = to yourself)

get.summary: Products for the AI prompt: status=draft|ai_filled|ready|incomplete|unfinished|all, ids=
Review panel: the card, what the last AI import changed (before → after), who reviewed it, current uk/en texts
Whole schema in all languages (the import format, with ids)

put.summary: Import a whole schema (schema-draft.json format; upsert, never deletes; optional product_moves [{from_category_slug, to_category_slug}])

get.summary: Category tree as a flat list (tree order) with counts and SEO

post.summary: Create category (parentId null = root; depth ≤ 2)

patch.summary: Edit category (null = keep; parentId "" = make root)

get.summary: May the caller see money (the main admin or «Финансы»)
Batch money: purchase, rate, expenses, cost per unit and margin

put.summary: Save currency, rate, allocation, «Все расходы внесены» and line prices / weights

post.summary: Add an expense to the batch (or to one line)

get.summary: P&L of the batch: spent, sold, profit, left on the shelf, days to sell out
The bytes of an expense document (inline; «Финансы» only)

post.summary: Attach a document to an expense: a photo or a PDF (invoice, declaration, statement)

get.summary: The official NBU rate for a date (a hint; the admin may type his own)
Old stock without a known cost («Начальная себестоимость»)

put.summary: Type the cost of the old stock of one product (variant); null clears it

get.summary: Profit of an order: revenue − cost of goods − acquiring fee
Product lots (FIFO), the cost that sells next and the margin at the current price

post.summary: «Выровнять»: lots match the stock of every product again

get.summary: «Метрики → Маржа»: revenue, cost, profit, by product / brand / category / batch
Prizes of every tier with their current chances (per tier)

post.summary: Add a prize to the gift case

delete.summary: Remove a prize from the gift case

patch.summary: Change rarity / weight / order / on-off of a prize

get.summary: Gifts of the order's customer this month against the monthly limit (before an admin adds a gift)
Brands and products whose orders get the case leaning to discounts

put.summary: Replace the low-margin brands (slugs) and products (ids)

get.summary: Gifts handed over in a period (dates inclusive, Kyiv) with per-person month totals
Last 30 days: orders with an automatic gift, with a case, cases opened
Case tiers (bronze / silver / gold): thresholds, guaranteed discount, swap percent
Products that fit a rarity of the tier by price (replacing a prize in the builder)

post.summary: «Автособрать»: a draft of prizes and chances for the tier from the catalog (nothing is saved)

put.summary: «Опубликовать» the case builder's draft: the tier's prizes become exactly these, at once

post.summary: «Тест кейса»: draw the tier N times (1…10 000) like the checkout; nothing is saved. lowMargin=true — as for an order with a low-margin product (product prizes rarer)

get.summary: Groups of rows in order of urgency, with counts (snoozed/dismissed rows hidden)

post.summary: Mark an informational row as handled (written to the admin journal)
Undo a snooze or dismissal: the row is shown again
Hide a row for 1 h / until 9:00 / 3 days (preset HOUR | TOMORROW | DAYS3)

get.summary: Open cases first; re-runs the detector (new cases appear, fixed ones close)

post.summary: Open a closed case again
Close a case with what was done
Revoke the current admin token
Revoke every token of the current admin (token_version + 1)

get.summary: Customers tab: buyers, repeat rate, cohorts, signups→buyers, promo codes, baskets
Revenue forecast for this month and the next 30 days, with backtest accuracy
Funnel tab: visited → product → cart → checkout → order → paid → shipped
Operations tab: median/p90 speed, stuck orders, reject reasons, delivery/payment mix
Overview tab: sold/received KPIs vs previous period, series, categories, channels, heatmap
Returns block: refunds by the date they went back and by channel, retained money, write-offs
Products & stock tab: stock value, dead/forgotten stock, top products, reorder list
Board strip: work queues, today's money vs yesterday, products running out
Paged/filterable/sortable order list (status + q + range, sortBy + sortDir)

post.summary: Create an order by hand (a sale by phone / in person): source ADMIN, no payment deadline

get.summary: Kanban board grouped by status (q filtered, newest first, capped). The range (rolling week|month|halfyear|year|all, calendar thismonth|prevmonth|thisyear|prevyear, or custom with from/to yyyy-MM-dd) applies to the closed columns (DELIVERED / REJECTED) only; closedLimit caps those columns.
All orders of a single user (newest first) — for the Users profile
Seller dispatch list — approved orders (+ NEW ones with includeNew=true) with COD amounts

post.summary: Post the dispatch cards of all approved orders to the seller Telegram topic
Mark ALL unread customer messages read

get.summary: Total unread customer messages across all orders (admin bell)

delete.summary: Deprecated: archives the order (orders are never deleted); reason required

get.summary: Order detail

post.summary: Archive a DELIVERED/REJECTED order (main admin only; reason required)
Upload a chat attachment (image or PDF) for this order; returns the object key
Approve: reject the order (CHANGED_MIND), restock, refund every paid monobank invoice in full
Decline with a comment (required) shown to the customer

patch.summary: Correct recipient name / phone / Nova Poshta city and branch (null fields unchanged)

post.summary: Apply/update/remove a discount (promo code or manual amount/percent)

Exchange on a delivered order: the returned units come back like a return (on their way or already in stock / written off), the replacement goes out as a NEW linked order with its own ТТН; returns the new order
Give the order a gift case: the server draws a prize now among the case prizes in stock (added at price 0); the customer opens it once the order is paid
Add a product line to the order (paid, or gift when gift=true)

delete.summary: Remove an order item (gift/line) and restore its stock

patch.summary: Change an order item's quantity (reserves/releases stock)

post.summary: Merge another open order of the same customer into this one: its lines, discount and received money move here, it is closed as REJECTED (MERGED); returns this order

get.summary: Other open (not shipped) orders of the same customer, each with what the merged order would be
Chat messages, newest page first (use before= to load older ones)

post.summary: Send a chat message (admin) — pings the customer
Mark customer messages as read

get.summary: monobank invoices of the order, newest first

post.summary: Ask monobank for the current state of the order's invoices
Refund a paid invoice to the card (all that is left, or amountMinor)

get.summary: Payment receipts of the order (fiscal checks + bank receipt) with signed download links

post.summary: Register a (partial) return: returned units per line, restock per line, refunded amount
The refused parcel is back at the shop: sellable units restocked, DEFECT lines written off
Return wizard: lines (RESTOCK/DEFECT/KEPT), manual refunds by channel, optional monobank refund, retained amount
Cancel the newest return / exchange: units back into the order, money back or as a debt
The customer sent back the money of a cancelled return

patch.summary: Correct the tracking number (ТТН) of a shipped / delivered order; the customer is told

post.summary: Bring an order back from the archive (main admin only)

get.summary: Templates filled in for an order, in the customer's language
List payment options (active only unless includeInactive=true)

put.summary: Save the list of payment options (upsert; missing ones are deactivated)

get.summary: Is monobank configured and reachable; the last webhook received
Admin auth smoke test
Batches: filter open (default) | arrived | cancelled | all

post.summary: New batch (ordered from a factory)

get.summary: A batch with its lines and queues

put.summary: Edit a batch: ETA, notes, lines (lines only before arrival)

post.summary: «Приехала»: add stock, set prices, hand out holds; dryRun=true only previews
Cancel a batch; closeQueue=true also closes the queues of its lines
Move an open batch: ORDERED / IN_TRANSIT / CUSTOMS

get.summary: Who waits for the lines of a batch
The waiting list of a batch as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, ';')
«Чего ждут»: lines with people in the queue, most wanted first

post.summary: Hand out holds after a restock outside a batch

get.summary: Pre-order numbers for a period (Kyiv dates, inclusive)
Who waits for a product (all variants, or one with variantId), live first
The waiting list of a product (or one variant) as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, ';')

delete.summary: Remove a person from a queue (a held unit goes to the next one)

get.summary: Suppliers (factories)

post.summary: New supplier

get.summary: List non-archived products; sort=demand puts the most waited-for first

post.summary: Create product

get.summary: List archived products

patch.summary: Update product (turning it active: 409 CARD_NOT_READY unless force=1, 409 PRODUCT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE {missing})
Toggle product active (publishing a DRAFT card: 409 CARD_NOT_READY unless force=1; no price/category: 409 PRODUCT_NOT_PUBLISHABLE {missing})

get.summary: List promo codes (with live reservations); origin=OURS|PERSONAL|REVIEW narrows the list

post.summary: Create promo code

get.summary: Orders with a manual amount/percent discount, newest first (max 200)

patch.summary: Update promo code (a code that was already used cannot be renamed)

get.summary: Orders placed with this code, newest first (max 100)
Is push configured on the server, the VAPID public key, subscribed devices of this admin

post.summary: Register this device (PushSubscription.toJSON()); idempotent
Send a test notification to this device (or all devices of this admin)
Forget this device

get.summary: All templates (all languages), in display order

post.summary: Create a template

get.summary: Reviews, newest first; status = PENDING | PUBLISHED | HIDDEN | ALL, optional productId

delete.summary: Delete a review for good (main admin only)

post.summary: Hide from the product page
Publish (the first published review of an order issues the customer's bonus code)
Public reply of the shop; blank text removes it

get.summary: All editable settings with metadata, defaults and current values

put.summary: Save a batch of settings (null = reset to default); all-or-nothing

get.summary: Read-only system facts: release version, last Nova Poshta sync

post.summary: Rebuild every page of the public site now; reports the site's answer

get.summary: Whether revalidation is configured, last success and last error (with time)
Attributes of a category (own + inherited, flagged) or the global ones

delete.summary: Delete attribute (409 ATTRIBUTE_IN_USE {count} unless force=1; force=1 — main admin only)

patch.summary: Edit attribute; options replace the list (removing a used one needs force=1)

post.summary: Rename (or merge) an option value and rewrite the products' specs

put.summary: Replace the list of groups (409 GROUP_IN_USE when removing a used one)

get.summary: Write-offs for a period (week | month | halfyear | year | all) with totals per reason

post.summary: Written off by mistake: put units back on the shelf (the write-off is kept, marked)

get.summary: Threads, latest activity first. filter = open (default) | awaiting | closed | all
One thread

post.summary: Upload an attachment for this thread; returns the object key
Close the thread

get.summary: Messages, newest page (before= for older ones), oldest-first

post.summary: Answer — the customer gets a bot DM with a button to the thread
Mark the customer's messages read
Reopen a closed thread

get.summary: Open threads waiting for an answer (nav badge)

post.summary: Re-issue the admin token (same admin, same token version, new expiry)

delete.summary: Delete translations of a whole language / entity type (main admin only)

put.summary: Mark translations as checked by a person; a stale one is re-bound to the current source (the admin confirmed it still fits)

get.summary: Translatable fields with source, sourceHash and status. status: missing|stale|translated|all

put.summary: Import translations; applied only when sourceHash matches the current source, MANUAL rows kept unless force
Proofreading: replace the Russian source of fields (optimistic by sourceHash) and write uk/en translations of the new source in one transaction

get.summary: translated / stale / missing per language and entity type

post.summary: Upload a product image (returns S3 key)

get.summary: Paged/searchable/sortable list of bot users
Map points (visitors grouped by place) seen in the last `days` (1..90) + online now
Distinct visitors with client events in the last 5 minutes (Mini App / site / total)
Signed-in users (and anonymous IPs) last seen at one map point
User analytics for range=month|halfyear|year|all (default month)
Public app info for the frontend

post.summary: First sign-in without 2FA: confirm the new secret with a code and sign in
First sign-in without 2FA: a new TOTP secret (QR / manual entry)
Admin sign-in, second factor: code from the authenticator app
Step 1: login + password → SETUP (new TOTP secret) or VERIFY (current code)
Is the link valid; what the form asks for
Step 2: the code — burns the link, activates the account, signs in
Admin sign-in, first factor: username + password
Admin sign-in, first factor: Telegram initData (single use, short TTL)
Customer login via Telegram initData
Finish a CONFIRMED login in the browser that started it; sets access + refresh
End the current site session and clear the cookies
Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access cookie (401 if none/invalid)
Start a bot login: returns the deep link + number to pick; sets login_bind

get.summary: Poll a login: PENDING | CONFIRMED | REJECTED | EXPIRED | USED
Catalog schema for the Mini App (categories, brands, characteristics), localized
Current customer profile

post.summary: Submit a batch of buffered client events

get.summary: My personal promo codes (review bonuses)
My cart with current prices, stock and availability

put.summary: Replace the whole cart (last write wins)

post.summary: Merge a guest cart into mine (same line: the larger quantity)

get.summary: My orders with unread admin messages (notifications inbox)

post.summary: Remember the customer's interface language

get.summary: List my orders
Get one of my orders

post.summary: Cancel an unpaid order (NEW/APPROVED) with an optional reason
Ask to cancel a PAID order (NEW/APPROVED); reason required, max 500. One request per order — an admin approves (cancel + refund) or declines with a comment
Open the gift case of my order (once, paid orders only): the prize drawn at checkout, the tier's prizes for the reel, the code of a discount prize and the swap offer
Pick the size of my case prize (a product with sizes) among those in stock while the order is being put together; 400 GIFT_CASE_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE when that size is gone or it is too late
Swap the case prize (similar to what I bought) for a personal code on the next order; the prize leaves the order. 400 GIFT_CASE_SWAP_UNAVAILABLE when it is not offered

get.summary: Chat messages, newest page first (use before= to load older ones)

post.summary: Send a chat message (customer)
Mark admin messages as read
Get a monobank payment page for what is due now (whole order or the prepayment). Reuses a live page; 409 with a code when the order cannot be paid
Ask monobank for the latest payment status now (after returning from the payment page) and return the order

get.summary: Payment receipts of the order: fiscal checks (sale / return) and the bank receipt per paid invoice, with short-lived signed download links. Empty on any failure
My places in queues: live first, then recent history

post.summary: Join the queue for an out-of-stock product/variant (again = change the quantity)

get.summary: Pre-order block of a product page, with my places in its queues

delete.summary: Leave a queue (a held unit goes to the next person)

post.summary: Validate a promo code and hold it for this customer

get.summary: My reviews with their status

post.summary: Review a line of my delivered order (or edit my review while it is PENDING)

get.summary: Lines of my delivered orders without a review (optionally of one order)

delete.summary: End all site sessions (including this one)

get.summary: Active site sessions; `current` marks the one making this request
Whether support is on and the message limits
My support threads, latest activity first

post.summary: Ask a question (optionally about a product); an open thread about the same product is reused

get.summary: One of my threads

post.summary: Close my thread (question answered)

get.summary: Messages, newest page (before= for older ones), oldest-first

post.summary: Write to my thread (reopens a closed one)
Mark the shop's answers read

get.summary: Unread shop answers across my threads
Total unread admin messages across my orders (bell)

post.summary: Upload a chat attachment

get.summary: Fetch a private attachment using a signed link
Search Nova Poshta cities
Search Nova Poshta warehouses for a city
Nova Poshta warehouses inside a map viewport (bounding box) for the map picker

post.summary: Place an order. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

get.summary: List active payment options (title/description translated for uk/en, ?lang= wins)

post.summary: monobank invoice status webhook (signed with X-Sign)

get.summary: List active, non-archived products
Get a single active product by UUID
Preview a promo code's discount for a subtotal

post.summary: Submit a batch of website events (anonymous or signed-in)

get.summary: Catalog schema (categories tree, brands, groups, characteristics, conditions), localized
Menu categories (tree order, parentId/artKind, subtree counts) + virtual utsenka last
One category by slug with the SEO of its page (seoTitle, seoDescription, h1, introText; null = site template), or 404
What the shop gives for the order sum now: the threshold, one product or the case prizes with chances; gift = null when off
Anti-bot order limits (0 = no limit)
«Скоро в наявності»: open batches, soonest first

Filtered, sorted, paginated products. category = slug (whole subtree) or utsenka (condition != NEW); sort: default|price_asc|price_desc|new|name; all=1 = no paging (max 1000); view=card = lightweight items (no description/SEO/tags, ≤ 2 images); unknown category slug → 404
Active product by its slug, or 404
Published reviews of a product (by id or slug), newest first, with the summary
Pre-order block of a product page for a guest
Newest published reviews with a text across the shop (home-page ribbon) and the shop-wide rating summary; product titles in the request language
Slugs for sitemap.xml
Whether support is on and the message limits (no auth)
Download a receipt PDF using a signed link from the receipts list
